agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse: Token.within() in sqlparse/sql.py was not checking isinstance(parent, group_cls) while walking the parent chain, so it always returned False. This broke tlist.within(sql.Function) / tlist.within(sql.Values) checks in ReindentFilter._process_identifierlist (sqlparse/filters/reindent.py), causing wrong reindent output for identifier lists with functions, long identifier lists with functions, insert values, and simple select-with-string-literal reindents. Restored proper isinstance check so within() correctly detects ancestry. Verified manually that all four reported scenarios now produce correct output, including the exact expected string "select 'abc'\nfrom my_table".
